_readme: Korean retrieval evaluation set. The 47 base/neighbor/tokenizer/proviso questions are about 특허·실용신안 심사기준; the crossref group also draws on 상표심사기준 and 지식재산권 권리회복 심사 가이드라인, so `document_filename` is a LIST and a question names its own document in `document` (absent = the first name). Scoring is per document: a gold page is the pair (document, page), never a bare page number.
Each entry was written by reading the passage first, then writing the question it answers.
gold_pages are PDF page numbers (chunks.page), NOT chunk ids: chunk ids change on
every re-ingestion, page numbers do not. `anchor` is a verbatim substring of the gold
passage - if the extractor changes and a page shifts, grep the anchor to re-locate it.

`group` splits the set. Absent or "base" is the original 21 questions. "neighbor" is the 8 written FROM measured proviso splits: the rule is in one chunk and the 다만/그러나 that qualifies it is in the NEXT one, so retrieving only the rule chunk yields a confidently wrong answer. Their `anchor` is the proviso sentence, which is what makes them able to detect NEIGHBOR_EXPANSION at all - the base questions cannot, because none of them was chosen for spanning a chunk boundary.

"tokenizer" is 8 questions that probe the known content_tsv bug: content_tsv is to_tsvector('simple', content), which does not segment Korean, so a josa stays glued to the noun and the document token 상표등록출원이나 never matches the query token 상표등록출원. Each was verified with plainto_tsquery('simple', ...) against the live corpus: the form in `query_form` matches ZERO chunks as a lexeme while the form in `doc_form` is what the corpus actually stores. `probe` says which way the mismatch runs - "bare->inflected" (question bare, document josa-glued) or "inflected->bare" (question josa-glued, document bare). query_form/doc_form are documentation, not scored. These questions can only be won by the dense side or by a tokenizer that segments Korean; a pure sparse run should fail them.

"proviso" is 10 questions where retrieving the main rule WITHOUT its 단서/다만 clause produces a confidently WRONG answer. Each is phrased so the main rule alone answers backwards - the exception case is asked about directly, or the yes/no flips on the proviso - and the `anchor` is the PROVISO sentence, never the main rule, which is what lets the metric see the failure. Includes double-negative (p04, p07) and condition-stacking (p05, p06, p09) phrasings. `why` records what the wrong answer would be on the main rule alone; documentation, not scored.

"crossref" is 25 questions whose answer needs a 준용/참조 hop. It was 5 and read anchor 0.800 for two days across every stage built - sparse bigrams, reranking, query expansion, neighbour expansion, classification-table chunking, hierarchical chunking, citation edges - and 0.800 at n=5 is ONE question, which is why it was enlarged before anything else was built. x01-x05 are the original manual-to-manual pointers: gold_pages lists both hops, pointer page first, and the `anchor` sits on the SECOND hop. x06-x25 were written from the corpus's REAL 준용 occurrences (254 clauses naming a 제N조 target; 128 of those targets exist elsewhere in the same document, 99 name a statute nobody uploaded). x06-x10 are the strongest shape available here and the one the owner's argument is about: the 권리회복 guideline prints 특허법 §16/§67의3/§81의3 in full and then says 실용신안법 §3/§15/§20 준용 them, so a question asked in 실용신안 vocabulary is answered by a sentence that says 특허 throughout and 실용신안 nowhere. Their gold_pages is the TARGET page only, so neither recall nor anchor can be won without the hop. MEASURED: all five are already answered by the deployed pipeline with no 준용 machinery of any kind - the embedding crosses the substitution on its own. The three anchor misses at n=25 are x01 (a 「제8부제2장 3.」 section-TITLE pointer, and its citing chunk sits at fused rank 10 with TOP_N=8), x11 (plain ranking: the whole 659-672 neighbourhood arrived and p.669 did not) and x23 (a 준용 조문 list split across two chunks with different ancestor lines). None is a 준용 failure.
